summary: Gibson County tower at 486 ft, code 9-3, marked removed on the Tennessee lookout table; no source describes the site now.

facts.status_note: Marked removed on the Tennessee lookout-tower table; no source describes what, if anything, remains at the site.

evidence.supports: Table row: Concord, Gibson County, 486 ft elevation, code 9-3, removed
Table numbers are state forest tower numbers (district-tower) from a 1976 list of towers
evidence.quote: Numbers in the table (e.g., 4-7) are state forest tower numbers (district-tower) from 1976 list of towers

evidence.supports: Civilian Conservation Corps erected 98 lookout towers in Tennessee, 1933 to 1941
evidence.quote: From 1933 to 1941, the Civilian Conservation Corps erected 98 lookout towers in Tennessee.

evidence.supports: Many towers removed; most former locations now private property
evidence.quote: Many have been removed, and most locations are now private property

notes_for_editor: One table row and the site's legend. Two searches found no other Concord record, and the NHLR and Forest Fire Lookout Association Tennessee lists do not include it. No build date, height, agency or photo found. The story uses the statewide CCC and private-land sentences from the same page for context only; the page does not tie this tower to either.
